hotels.vendor_name: Amoh, a Luxury Collection Resort, Rhodes
hotels.title: Grand Opening: Greek Islands Glamour with Private Beach Access, Daily Breakfast & EUR150 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Be one of the first to discover this sophisticated adults-oriented sanctuary, rising from an ancient quarry on Rhodes' southeastern peninsula. Inspired by the myth cycles of the Dodecanese Islands, this stay is steeped in Greece's extraordinary history and offers private access to one of the island's most spectacular private beaches. Sprawling spa retreat ELISPA features wellness rituals that draw on the island's renowned healing traditions, while restaurants and bars celebrate the island's culinary heritage, from seafood-focused house of fine dining Kymata Restaurant to farm-sourced Mediterranean fare and views over the quarry ruins at Cava di Pietra. Beyond the resort's peninsula setting, guests discover Rhodes through curated cultural experiences - story nights with local storytellers, ceramic workshops with Rhodian artisans and guided excursions to ancient sites. The iconic village of Lindos captivates with its whitewashed alleyways leading to the dramatic Acropolis perched above the sea, while secluded coves and crystal-clear waters dot the coastline within easy reach of this exclusive retreat.

hotels.vendor_name: Caesars Gardens Hotel & Spa - Adults Only- Rhodes, Greece
hotels.title: Boutique Greek Island Adults-Only Retreat with Outdoor Pool & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Seamlessly blending into Rhodes' natural landscape, this intimate, adults-only hotel is where Greek Island sophistication meets rustic charm. The crown jewel is the Magnolia Spa, featuring outdoor treatment pavillions amid ancient olive trees, while Tárate Restaurant serves traditional Greek cuisine using herbs and vegetables from the hotel's garden. Beyond the hotel's tranquil grounds, guests can explore Rhodes' immense southeastern coastline, with pristine beaches and hidden coves dotting the shoreline. Adventure seekers can discover ancient ruins perched dramatically on clifftops, while the nearby village of Lindos captivates with its maze of whitewashed alleyways, traditional tavernas and local craft boutiques.
